OCRelay 1.1.30

FIX: PICKING A STUDY NO LONGER STARTS A CAPTURE

• The Study list sits over the Capture button, and picking a study there could start a capture by accident. A study is now picked when you let go of the mouse button over it.
• The Capture button also ignores a click for half a second after a list closes, so double-clicking a study doesn't capture either.
• Applies to every dropdown list. The capture hotkey works as before.
